name: holdfast-web
description: Holdfast browser terminal client (WebTransport with WebSocket fallback).

scripts.build: npm run proto:generate && esbuild src/client/app.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=esm --sourcemap && cp public/index.html dist/ && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css dist/
scripts.test: tsx src/spike/terminal-safety.test.ts && tsx src/client/transport.test.ts && tsx src/client/inserted-text.test.ts && tsx src/client/font-size.test.ts
